thread:
alice: T-minus 20 for the EU change window. Quick live checklist — pins, canary, smoke, rollback ready. @release-manager you okay with the pin list? :eyes:
ben: Reviewing now. Can we confirm the canary weight and whether embeddings route is pinned separately?
release-manager: Canary 5% for 15m, then 25% for 30m if stable. Embeddings routed to v2.8-quant, pinned for the window.
carol: Deploybot shows a warmup for dedicated pool, but we need to ensure autoscale is enabled for the next hour. @sre-oncall can you keep an eye on GPU scale events?
sre-oncall: On it. I’ll watch autoscale and set alerts on GPU_util > 85% for 3m. DM me if we need to bump burst capacity.
dave: Small note — telemetry team flagged a regression in request tracing that might spike errors on rollouts. It only affects verbose traces but worth watching.
alice: Good catch. We’ll include tracing SLI in the smoke. If traces error > 1% for 5m, rollback.
ben: Confirming release notes snippet is pushed to the docs site (link: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-eu-slice).
release-manager: Docs updated. Also added the rollback playbook link and quick rollback commands.
carol: Deploybot starting canary now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary start accepted — service=redwood-inference-api env=prod-eu model=v3.2.4-canary weight=5% duration=15m request: `/deploy start --service inference --env prod-eu --model v3.2.4-canary --weight 5`
dave: Smoke run kicked off: `curl -sS https://api.eu.redwood.ai/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq .status`
sre-oncall: Seeing transient 502s on the first minute, now stabilized. Currently 0.4% error across canary requests. Monitoring continues.
alice: OK — below rollback threshold. Re-target canary to 25% after 15m if no regression. Who's owning the 15m check?
ben: I can lead the 15m check. I’ll post perf + errors + cost delta.
release-manager: Approve move to 25% if checks green. If errors > 1% or latency p95 increases > 30% from baseline, automatic rollback.
carol: Noted. Also enabling prefix cache warmup in prod to reduce latency spikes — patch applied.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary update accepted — weight=25% in 15m window start=6187654366
sre-oncall: Alert: autoscale triggered 2x nodes at +7m, no flapping. Logging normal.
dave: Tracing regression still at 0.6% — looks isolated to long-tail requests. Tracking under tracing-ticket #INF-642.
alice: All right, team. If anything hits rollback criteria, call it in this thread and run the quick rollback command from the playbook. Otherwise we’ll proceed to full rollout after 45m. :thumbsup:
ben: Rollout metrics at +20m — errors 0.45%, p95 +10%, cost delta +3%. Green to proceed.
release-manager: Proceed to ramp to 100% over 30m per rollout matrix. Posting final runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/release-2026-03-eu-slice
alice: Thanks everyone. Keep this channel for any hot issues. I’ll file a short retro note after the window. :white_check_mark:
